title: Escape or a click outside keeps the Move window, Cancel closes it
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: You start moving customers to Net 45 and then press Escape, click outside or cancel.
  • You are an Admin user working at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Net 30 is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 15 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly three customers, {Customer-A}, {Customer-B} and {Customer-C} (a new term holds only this case's customers), whose names are in that A to Z order, with credit limits of $500.00, $0.00 and $1,000.00.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-20 N15, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-20 Alpha, {Customer-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-20 Bravo and {Customer-C} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-20 Charlie.
  • Starting screen: the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Untick {Customer-B}.
  4. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  5. Press Escape.
  6. Click on the page outside the window.
  7. Click "Cancel".
  8. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  9. Click "Move Customers".
  10. Click the close icon at the top right of the window.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: "2 selected".
  • Step 4: the dropdown shows Net 45.
  • Step 5: the window stays open with the same ticks and Net 45.
  • Step 6: the window stays open, unchanged.
  • Step 7: the window closes, no toast shows, and the three customers are still on {Term-A}.
  • Step 8: the menu opens.
  • Step 9: the window opens with all three ticked again.
  • Step 10: the window closes without moving anyone.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • S4-R22: “Pressing Escape or clicking outside the Move Customers window does not close it, and keeps the search, ticks and "Move To" choice. "Cancel" or the close icon closes it without moving anyone.”
  • Key Decisions: “Departure: the New Credit Term and Move Customers windows do not close on Escape or a click outside.”
